finding.summary: Possibly missing imports for symbols newly used in the diff (`isSrng` in arguments.ts, `Range` in cell-index.ts / readonly.ts), which would break the build
finding.evidence: arguments.ts introduces `isSrng(node.v)` with no import hunk in the diff; cell-index.ts introduces `bounds(): Range | undefined` and readonly.ts `async getUsedBounds(): Promise<Range | undefined>` with no import hunks either. If any of these files did not already import the symbol, compilation fails.

decision.reason: Cannot verify: the working directory /tmp/eval-item-hRoO8Z/repo contains no source files (Glob '**/*' and '**/*.ts' return nothing), so the import blocks of arguments.ts, cell-index.ts and readonly.ts are unreadable. The diff-level claims do hold: isSrng(node.v) is added at diff.patch:558 with the file's only hunk starting at line 108 (diff.patch:549, no import hunk); bounds(): Range | undefined added at diff.patch:874 with only hunk @@ -120,6 +120,34 @@ (diff.patch:865); getUsedBounds(): Promise<Range | undefined> added at diff.patch:948 with only hunk @@ -154,6 +154,10 @@ (diff.patch:944). Other files in the same PR do add import hunks when they need new symbols (formula.ts diff.patch:577-580, memory.ts diff.patch:906), so the omission is unresolved rather than clearly benign. Without the pre-image I cannot establish that these symbols were already imported, so no named refutation ground (not-present/already-guarded/out-of-scope/pre-existing) applies and the finding stays. A missing import would be a hard build break on the primary path.
